scope: All future GOLD_ML_V1 candidate discovery, refinement, filtering, model selection, and promotion decisions

hard_gates.reason: Batch023 cost stress and fresh prospective confirmation are not complete
unlock_requires: cost stress completed on RAW_RECONSTRUCTED rows
fresh prospective confirmation completed from goldsharp closed bars
explicit audit record authorizing a new exploration batch

rules: No threshold, feature, filter, direction, horizon, TP, SL, or rule may be changed after looking at 2024 or 2025 results.
2026 may never be used for tuning, candidate selection, threshold selection, or rescue of a failed candidate.
Temporal ordering must be preserved; no random split may replace the fixed year split.

must_record: all planned metrics and pass gates
forbidden: removing losing candidates from the denominator after results are known
changing the pool to improve apparent hit rate
creating a new ID without preserving the parent and exact change
calling a derivative candidate independent of its parent lineage

required: record total seeds and neighborhood cells
report search multiplicity beside final performance
forbidden: selecting the best seed after seeing all seeds
selecting the best neighborhood cell after seeing all cells
changing bootstrap or stability criteria after results
repeatedly modifying a rule until 2024 or 2025 passes
treating correlated same-lineage variants as independent confirmations

data_and_feature_integrity.raw_time: bar-open time in MT5 server time
required: no future bars in features, eligibility, labels, or exits
exact M1 entry availability enforced where required
same-M1 collision priority frozen before evaluation
source hashes and row ranges recorded
all feature formulas and warmup rules versioned
forbidden: using WARMUP_BRIDGE_EXACT rows for exploration, tuning, model selection, or live decisions
mixing historical gold_v3 rows with live goldsharp decisions
using proxy features as exact features without a separate label
silently changing ATR, RCI, Bollinger, spread, time-exit, or timestamp contracts
using post-cutoff data in historical candidate discovery

minimum_required_stages: raw replay or explicitly labeled bridge audit
stability checks appropriate to the search
evaluation_and_promotion.failed_stage_behavior: preserve artifacts and stop; do not rescue by retuning on later periods

reporting.bridge_policy: RAW_RECONSTRUCTED and WARMUP_BRIDGE_EXACT must be separated in every table and decision
